title: The waiting page shows each open question's mockup in a Designs tab
why: Your idea, via the coordinator, and your word (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2NiD3qW1ALmG6Ty5dJjHHeS): full mockups inline on the waiting page, so mockups stop arriving as separate artifacts.
note: A question may carry designs: [{slug, label}]; its card shows the full mockup in a sandboxed frame, and a Designs tab pages through every design whose question is open. Each mockup is stored whole in the page and leaves at the next republish once its question is answered. Designers (d10) hand their mockup HTML to the page's owner session instead of publishing it. Checked Oct 26 22:58 CDT: 16 MB per page and about 52 KB per mockup, so about 300 fit; other artifacts cannot be framed and the asset store refuses HTML, so inline is the only route. Unmeasured: whether the claude.ai viewer runs a srcdoc frame; your first look at the mockup answers it. Rides with c100 and c99. Port: yes, with the waiting page. Placed after c106 (triage, Oct 27): it rides with the page's final look.
